name: The link-loss edge of the audio task resets once per outage
step: The link-loss edge of the audio task resets once per outage
rationale:
Ported from rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite PR #2581 (issue #2437): the disconnected branch
of tasks/audio_events.lua's wakeup was entered as a state test, not an edge, so its state
reset ran on every audio tick while the link was down. The reset now runs once per outage,
on the first disconnected tick, and the first connected tick re-arms it. Nothing in the
reset is written while the link is down, so the behaviour does not change; what changes is
the work done on each tick of an outage.

The harness pins what the edge must keep: a change made during an outage is not spoken after
the reconnect, and the loss and the recovery of an armed model are announced for each of two
outages. Its can-fail check removes the re-arm from a copy of the task and requires the second
outage to go silent there. Passing on unpatched master is expected: this is a structural
change with no audible effect, so the harness guards the behaviour, not the saving.
